title: DiamondAntiBadWords
description: Advanced chat moderation plugin that filters configurable bad words, issues warnings, and auto-mutes players with smart detection and 24-hour warn reset.
body:
# 💬 DiamondAntiBadWords

DiamondAntiBadWords is a modern, lightweight chat moderation plugin for Minecraft 1.21–1.21.11 (Spigot, Paper, Bukkit, Leaf).
It automatically filters configurable bad words, warns players, and mutes repeat offenders — all with smart bypass detection.

~~-------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

# ✨ Features

- 🔍 Smart bad word detection (prevents bypass like b1tch, b!tch, etc.)
- ✂ Automatically replaces blocked words with *****
- ⚠ Configurable warning system
- 🔁 Warns reset automatically after 24 hours
- 🔇 Auto-mute system after max warns
- ⏳ Configurable mute duration
- 🛠 Fully configurable blocked words in config.yml
- 🚫 Bypass permission for staff
- ⚡ Lightweight & optimized

~~-------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

# 📜 Commands

- /dabw help            -   Shows plugin help
- /dabw reload          -   Reloads configuration
- /dabw mute <player>   -   Manually mute a player
- /dabw unmute <player> -   Unmute a player

~~-------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

# 🔐 Permissions

- dabw.admin - Access to reload, mute, unmute
- dabw.bypass - Bypass word filter

~~-------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

# ⚙ Configuration

- Add or remove blocked words easily
- Change max warns (default: 3)
- Change mute time (default: 30 minutes
- Customize warning message
Everything is editable inside config.yml


~~-------------------------------------------------------------------------~~

# 🧱 Compatibility

- ✅ Paper 1.21–1.21.11
- ✅ Spigot 1.21–1.21.11
- ✅ Bukkit
Requires Java 17+
